newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Kingspan buys Rom companies for 2.04mln punt.
newsitem.headline: Kingspan buys Rom companies for 2.04mln punt.

text.p: Kingspan Group Plc said on Thursday that it was acquiring the Rom group of companies for a total consideration of 2.036 million Irish pounds.
The Rom companies are engaged primarily in the manufacture and distribution of rotationally moulded products for the agricultural and building industries, Kingspan said in a statement.
They include Rom Plastics Limited, Rom Plastics (Sales) Limited, Rosplas Teoranta and Carlisle Limited. Their combined net assets amounted to 1.779 million punts at September 30, 1996.
Kingspan said the acquisition would help it in developing and growing the market for rotationally moulded products in Ireland and Britain.
